column1: # The same carriers, serialised by the operator tooling rather than by the node.
# The two libraries frame a bag of cells differently, so these bytes are not the
# ones beside them in vote-carrier-vectors.tsv. They are here so the node's reader is
# held to what the tooling actually sends: a test that only read back its own
# output would pass two changes that suited each other and nothing else.
# Written by the Rust carrier test with TOS_WRITE_CARRIER_TOOLING=1.
